components.name: Primary button
components.description: Filled blue action with the shared control target and focus treatment.
components.css: .ds-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:48px;padding:10px 16px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--control-radius,8px);font:600 14px/1.4 var(--font, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif);cursor:pointer;background:var(--accent, #2563eb);color:var(--surface, #ffffff);transition:background 150ms ease-out;}.ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled){background:var(--accent-hover, #1d4ed8);}.ds-primary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent, #2563eb);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-primary:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-primary{transition:none;}}

components.name: Secondary action
components.css: .ds-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:48px;padding:10px 16px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--control-radius,8px);font:600 14px/1.4 var(--font, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif);cursor:pointer;background:var(--surface, #ffffff);color:var(--ink, #111827);border-color:var(--line, #dce1e9);font:600 14px/1.55 var(--font, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif);text-decoration:none;}.ds-secondary:hover{background:var(--surface-soft, #f8fafc);}.ds-secondary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent, #2563eb);outline-offset:3px;}

components.name: Quiet action
components.description: Contextual text action within a case workflow.
components.css: .ds-quiet{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:48px;padding:10px 16px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:var(--control-radius,8px);font:600 14px/1.4 var(--font, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif);cursor:pointer;padding-inline:0;background:transparent;color:var(--accent-ink, #1e40af);text-align:left;}.ds-quiet:hover{text-decoration:underline;}.ds-quiet:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent, #2563eb);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-quiet:disabled{opacity:.55;cursor:not-allowed;}

components.name: Labeled field
components.description: Persistent label, readable input value, and outlined boundary.
components.css: .ds-field-label{display:grid;gap:7px;color:var(--ink, #111827);font:600 14px/1.55 var(--font, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif);}.ds-field{width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:48px;padding:10px 12px;border:1px solid var(--line-strong, #aeb9c9);border-radius:var(--control-radius,8px);background:var(--surface, #ffffff);color:var(--ink, #111827);caret-color:var(--accent, #2563eb);font:400 16px/1.55 var(--font, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif);}.ds-field::placeholder{color:#65738a;opacity:1;}.ds-field:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent, #2563eb);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-field:read-only{background:var(--surface-soft, #f8fafc);color:var(--muted, #526075);}

components.name: Case section navigation
components.description: Five equal-weight case destinations, with full labels in three columns on mobile.
components.html: ОбзорЗадачиДокументыСообщенияОплаты
components.css: .ds-case-nav{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px;padding:8px;border:1px solid var(--line, #dce1e9);border-radius:12px;background:var(--surface, #ffffff);}.ds-case-link{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex:1;gap:8px;min-height:48px;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:7px;color:var(--muted, #526075);text-decoration:none;font:600 15px/1.55 var(--font, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif);white-space:nowrap;}.ds-case-link:hover{color:var(--accent-ink, #1e40af);background:var(--surface-soft, #f8fafc);}.ds-case-link[aria-current=page]{color:var(--accent-ink, #1e40af);background:#e8efff;}.ds-case-link:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent, #2563eb);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-case-link svg{flex-shrink:0;}@media(max-width:700px){.ds-case-nav{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px;padding:6px;}.ds-case-link{flex-direction:column;gap:4px;min-height:60px;padding:6px 4px;font-size:14px;}.ds-case-link svg{width:18px;height:18px;}}

components.name: Inline disclosure
components.description: Secondary content expands in place with the shipped disclosure motion.
components.html:
Изменить данные
Форма открывается здесь, сохраняя контекст дела.
components.css: .ds-disclosure{border:1px solid var(--line, #dce1e9);border-radius:var(--radius,12px);background:var(--surface, #ffffff);font:400 16px/1.55 var(--font, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif);}.ds-disclosure-summary{min-height:48px;padding:16px 20px;color:var(--accent-ink, #1e40af);font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;}.ds-disclosure-summary:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent, #2563eb);outline-offset:3px;}.ds-disclosure-body{padding:0 20px 24px;color:var(--muted, #526075);}.ds-disclosure[open]>.ds-disclosure-body{animation:ds-disclosure-in 180ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1);}@keyframes ds-disclosure-in{from{transform:translateY(-3px);}to{transform:translateY(0);}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-disclosure[open]>.ds-disclosure-body{animation:none;}}

narrative.overview:
A calm, familiar workspace for a client and the team handling a legal case. White surfaces sit on a cool gray canvas; blue identifies actions and the current location. The same visual vocabulary supports mobile client work and the denser staff workspace, with readable text, explicit labels, and functional grouping.

The user selected a code-led replacement of the previous visual identity and explicitly chose a system sans interface. The retained brand commitment is the name «Современная защита». The built identity adds an outlined shield-and-check SVG within a blue rounded tile; navigation uses the existing authored outline SVG set. There is no decorative photography, raster illustration, display-font treatment, or simulated material.
keyCharacteristics: White outlined panels on a cool gray canvas.
Blue actions and clearly tinted current navigation.
System sans text with restrained weight and size hierarchy.
Labeled controls, spacious hit areas, and contextual inline disclosures.
Shared component language across client, staff, authentication, and chat.

rules.name: The Action and State Rule
rules.body: Use blue for actions and location; use success, warning, and danger colors for the condition the accompanying text names.

rules.name: The Reading Baseline Rule
rules.body: Keep body text, typed field values, and chat messages at 16px; express secondary hierarchy through supporting roles rather than shrinking the main reading task.

rules.name: The Context Stays Rule
rules.body: Expand secondary forms inline within the surrounding workspace, and preserve visible navigation when changing case sections.

rules.name: The Flat Workspace Rule
rules.body: Keep ordinary surfaces flat; reserve the menu shadow for controls that float above the workspace.

dos: Do reuse the shared cool neutrals, action blue, and semantic feedback pairs.
Do retain 16px body, input, and message text and the shared visible focus treatment.
Do keep repeated controls at least 48px high and mobile client case navigation cells at least 60px high.
Do preserve full client case-section names, equal cell widths, and an explicit active state.
Do use the authored outline SVG components and the existing geometric brand mark.
Do keep secondary forms contextual and honor reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't add decorative imagery or display typography to this selected interface world.
Don't turn flat working panels into raised promotional cards.
Don't encode status solely through color or replace navigation labels with icons alone.
Don't treat generated sidecar tonal ramps as additional approved application tokens.
